newsitem.title: USA: Arden unit to take action after Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Arden unit to take action after Q1 loss.

text.p: Arden Fasteners, a subsidiary of Arden Industrial Products Inc, said Tuesday it will take what officials called "corrective actions" after posting a net loss in the first quarter.

Michael Lindseth, the company's newly installed chief executive officer, did not specify what steps will be taken to fix what he described as "operational issues facing the company." However, Lindseth stressed that a new focus will be placed on improving profitability.

Arden Fasteners, a distributor of specialty and standard fasteners to the industrial market, reported a net loss of $101,000, or $0.01 per share in the first quarter on revenues of #23.7 million. The company lost $36,000, or $0.01 per share, in the corresponding period one year ago on sales of $19.9 million.
